name: WEAI 102nd Annual Conference
venue: Hilton Hawaiian Village, 2005 Kalia Road, Honolulu
conf_dates_note: In-person program June 27 - July 1, 2027; virtual sessions June 23, 2027 via Zoom
deadline_note: Volunteer individual papers due December 31, 2026 (submission opens October 15). Discussants/chairs: February 1, 2027. Organized session information: February 15, 2027. Complete papers uploaded by June 1.
submission_requirements: Abstract of 350 words or less; WEAI account and payment of submission + registration fee required before abstract details can be submitted. Organized sessions submitted by email (sessions@weai.org)
submission_fee: USD 80 members / USD 110 non-members (non-refundable; paid together with registration)
registration_fee: Volunteer paper package: USD 275 professional members (80 submission + 195 registration) / USD 385 professional non-members (110 + 275) / USD 175 student members (80 + 95) / USD 245 student non-members (110 + 135); registration portion fully refundable if paper not accepted
membership_required: Not required; members pay lower fees
journal: Members get a journal submission fee waiver for Economic Inquiry or Contemporary Economic Policy submissions made within six months after the conference
